hero.subtitle: Etiel Mining Hub supplies high-performance metal detectors, ground scanners, and field-ready mining hardware for gold prospectors, commercial operators, and geological exploration across Ethiopia with expert device selection and local technical counseling.

fieldTested.title: Nokta Magnetar 9000
fieldTested.body: A professional pulse induction gold detector built for deep gold and micro nuggets in mineralized ground. Dual Receiver Coil (DRC) technology with the MG37 search coil balances extreme depth and fine sensitivity in one platform. Fully waterproof to 3 meters, with Easy and Expert menus for both first-time and advanced prospectors. Available through Etiel Mining Hub in Addis Ababa with local device selection and field guidance.
fieldTested.point1: Advanced pulse induction for mineralized soil
fieldTested.point2: MG37 DRC coil for depth and small gold
fieldTested.point3: IP68 waterproof, up to 3 m submersion
fieldTested.imageAlt: Nokta Magnetar 9000 with MG37 DRC search coil

detail.deployBody: Secure your operations with guaranteed response times and priority logistics.

onsite_assembly.name: On-Site Assembly
onsite_assembly.tagline: Factory-trained crews commission heavy equipment at your pit or plant with full systems validation.
onsite_assembly.description: Factory-trained technicians deploy and commission equipment at your pit or plant with full systems checks.
onsite_assembly.overview1: Our installation teams arrive with calibrated tooling, OEM procedures, and a commissioning checklist tailored to your model and site power profile.
onsite_assembly.overview2: From unpacking through first-cut acceptance, we document every torque value and safety interlock so your operators inherit a ready, warranty-clean machine.

commission.title: Full Commissioning
commission.body: Power-on, calibration, and acceptance tests against Etiel factory baselines.

integration.title: Site Integration
integration.body: Interface with local power, dust, and haul routes so the unit fits your operation from day one.

training.title: Operator Handover
training.body: On-console walkthroughs so your crew can run the asset safely after we demobilize.

field_support.name: 24/7 Field Support
field_support.tagline: Rapid-response technical support and emergency repair services to minimize operational downtime.
field_support.description: Round-the-clock remote diagnostics and dispatch so critical assets stay productive when conditions turn harsh.
field_support.overview1: Our specialized response units are strategically positioned to provide rapid assistance. Equipped with advanced diagnostic tools and critical spare parts, they ensure that your machinery is back online with minimal delay.
field_support.overview2: With a global network of certified engineers, we offer seamless support across all major mining regions. From remote troubleshooting to on-site overhauls, our team is dedicated to maximizing your fleet's uptime.

repairs.title: Emergency Repairs
repairs.body: On-site mechanical and electrical interventions to restore critical production assets fast.

remote.title: Remote Diagnostics
remote.body: Live telemetry review and guided troubleshooting before a crew rolls to site.

scheduled.title: Scheduled Maintenance
scheduled.body: Planned service windows that keep fleets within OEM intervals without surprise downtime.

operator_cert.name: Operator Certification
operator_cert.tagline: Hands-on programs that bring crews to safe, peak operating standards on Etiel fleets.
operator_cert.description: Hands-on certification programs that bring crews up to safe, peak operating standards on Etiel fleets.
operator_cert.overview1: Training blends classroom fundamentals with supervised seat time on the exact models in your yard, covering start-up, load cycles, and emergency procedures.
operator_cert.overview2: Graduates leave with Etiel credentials and site-specific checklists your supervisors can audit against every shift.

classroom.title: Classroom Modules
classroom.body: Systems theory, safety culture, and fault recognition tailored to your fleet mix.

field.title: Field Seat Time
field.body: Supervised operation on production machines under realistic site conditions.

assessment.title: Skills Assessment
assessment.body: Practical exams and written checks before certification is issued.

predictive.name: Predictive Diagnostics
predictive.tagline: Sensor-driven health monitoring that flags wear before it becomes downtime.
predictive.description: Sensor-driven health monitoring that flags wear patterns before they become unplanned downtime.
predictive.overview1: We instrument critical drivetrains and hydraulics, then trend vibration, oil, and temperature signals against Etiel baselines for your model family.
predictive.overview2: When thresholds trip, your team gets actionable alerts—and optional auto-dispatch into Field Support—so small issues never become lost shifts.

sensors.title: Sensor Suite
sensors.body: Retrofittable packs for vibration, oil condition, and thermal hotspots.

analytics.title: Trend Analytics
analytics.body: Model-aware thresholds that learn your duty cycle instead of generic alarms.

dispatch.title: Linked Dispatch
dispatch.body: Escalate straight into Field Support with fault context already attached.

leasing.name: Capital Equipment Leasing
leasing.tagline: Flexible procurement paths that keep capital free while your fleet stays current.
leasing.description: Flexible procurement paths for artisanal teams and mid-tier fleets without locking all capital upfront.
leasing.overview1: Structure terms around production seasons and ore cycles—lease what you need now, with clear upgrade and buyout options as the operation grows.
leasing.overview2: Etiel coordinates equipment, insurance guidance, and service attachments so financing never strands you without support coverage.

flexible.title: Flexible Terms
flexible.body: Seasonal payment profiles matched to your production calendar.

upgrade.title: Upgrade Paths
upgrade.body: Swap into newer models mid-term when output targets rise.

support.title: Bundled Support
support.body: Attach Field Support or diagnostics packages to the same agreement.
